dependency_semantics: depends_on is authoritative; blocks is its normalized inverse, including the T-22 all-ticket exit dependency.

label_catalog.blocking:upstream: Has one or more downstream dependents
label_catalog.fixture-slice:base-eligible: Fixture-only slice may be delegated at base tier
label_catalog.review:highest: Pattern-setting change requiring highest review scrutiny
label_catalog.status:blocked: Open and waiting for one or more declared dependencies

issues.title: T-03 — Implement append-only event and artifact store
issues.body:
## Scope
Implement the append-only event and artifact store for the Stage 1 deterministic runtime core.

## References
- Event, episode, and common-definition schemas
- `INV-005`
- `INV-015`

## Dependencies
None.

## Exit tests
- [ ] Atomic append survives forced interruption without a partial record.
- [ ] Duplicate event IDs are rejected.
- [ ] Canonical-content and event-log hashes verify.
- [ ] A one-byte stored-content mutation fails verification.

Stage boundary: Workstreams 1B–1E plus T-22 only; no Stage 2+ work.
exit_tests: Atomic append survives forced interruption without a partial record
Duplicate event IDs are rejected
Canonical-content and event-log hashes verify
A one-byte stored-content mutation fails verification
